scope: Read-only source inspection and transformations of separate temporary copies. No frozen binaries, image bundles, active build inputs or running camera changed.

transformation.debuggerStrategy: Retain original full binary/symbols off-device. Strip an image-specific derivative before making its immutable bundle manifest; validate new hashes and executable behavior. Existing SDK deliberately exempts both camera binaries from late stripping to preserve manifest hashes.

emulatedSmoke.scope: Temporary stripped copies in ARM/v7 emulation only; no board or image changes

compressionEstimates.limit: These are whole-file estimates. Actual SquashFS compressor/block settings, fragment packing and layout determine flash-image savings. Do not equate uncompressed/debug/notice bytes with image bytes.

existingFeatureSubset.scope: Current CMakeCache and build-qr-native-bench.py already disable non-QR functionality. Further major feature-pruning savings are not established.

dependencyOptions.option: Remove host build toolchains from target
dependencyOptions.assessment: LLVM/Rust compilers are build-host tools; no target toolchain size has been identified in the camera image payload. Do not count host build-cache GB as image savings.

dependencyOptions.option: Remove optional cv2/numpy/pygame and legacy QR libraries if present
dependencyOptions.assessment: Pinned app catches missing imports and native fixed-camera/QR path does not need them. Actual final-rootfs presence/bytes must be inventoried before claiming savings; desktop/Pi and fallback features would change.

dependencyOptions.option: Trim dependency self-tests only in runtime packaging
dependencyOptions.assessment: Diagnostic dependency overlay contains SelfTest, unused by app imports. This is not an inventory of the final3.23Buildroot package; only count savings if present there.
These include functional fonts/icons/locales. Removing them changes UI/language coverage and is lower priority than debug removal.
13,722,140-byte original notice is only97,564bytes under whole-file xz6 estimate. Preserve notices; do not assume13MiBflash savings or precompress blindly inside already-compressed SquashFS.

dependencyOptions.option: Rust size-oriented optimization or minimal runtime-only CLI
dependencyOptions.assessment: Rust camera already lacks DWARF and symbol tables. Alternative opt-level/z/LTO or removing diagnostics needs a separate build and new hardware validation; no safe large saving is measured.

recommendedPriority: Strip QR worker derivative before hashing; measured raw7,536,124B saving, estimated xz1,589,296B/gzip2,154,435B saving.
Inventory actual final SquashFS file sizes and package ownership for whole-image reductions; camera/QR code after strip is about2.42MB combined uncompressed.
Keep current baseline frozen and active build intact; any slimming profile gets its own reproducible manifest/hash and runtime checks.
